Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely asserted the cause of death as “pulmonary hemorrhage” and minimized tuberculosis without authoritative confirmation, while also failing to resolve the foundational ambiguity about which wife was meant (Murry had multiple wives, both reported to have died of tuberculosis). This mischaracterization and unresolved ambiguity propagated to the final step, leading to an incorrect/hedged answer and a premature “TASK_COMPLETE” despite unresolved discrepancies and lack of solid citations.
